PHA-EUR.summary: PHA has a fresh exchange-access risk: Phemex delisted PHA/USDT spot on September 18, 2026, including deposit/withdrawal closure. This is not evidence of a protocol failure, but can reduce venue liquidity and increase fragmentation risk.
materialRisks: Phemex delisted the PHA/USDT spot pair on September 18, 2026; deposits and withdrawals were also closed, creating recent exchange-access/liquidity risk for PHA.

facts.fact: Phemex’s September 17 announcement states that PHA/USDT spot was delisted at 07:00 UTC on September 18, with pending orders removed and PHA deposits/withdrawals unavailable thereafter. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100307?utm_source=openai))

Kraken’s support page, updated September 1, 2026, says PHA/EUR spot trading remains available, although Khala-network funding had previously been discontinued as part of the Khala sunset/migration process. ([support.kraken.com](https://support.kraken.com/au/articles/changes-to-phala-on-kraken?utm_source=openai))

Phala’s status page reported all listed services operational on September 25, and its incident page shows no reported incidents for July–September 2026. ([status.phala.network](https://status.phala.network/incidents?utm_source=openai))
